negatives.evidence: Plastic HO GP35 makers per Model Railroad News (2016): Athearn 1966, Kato 1992, Bachmann 1994, Athearn RTR 2005, MTH, WalthersProto 2017 — the 2017 WalthersProto GP35 was the FIRST GP35 ever in Proto's catalog after years of rumors. Life-Like appears in none of them. Zero Life-Like GP35 comps in the 3,110-comp guide. CORROBORATED Nov 27: the Proto 2000 all-time release timeline (TrainOrders forum, 1989-2006, every P2K HO diesel release) lists NO GP35 anywhere.
negatives.source: Model Railroad News, 'Walthers Proto GP35 in HO scale due early 2017'; guide check 2026-11-26; TrainOrders P2K timeline corroboration 2026-11-27

shares.tell: Underside stamp settles Atlas vs Con-Cor: Con-Cor sold the same Rivarossi shell on a Kato chassis; Atlas's documented E8 roads were Santa Fe, B&O, PRR, UP, C&NW. A road outside that list (e.g. Amtrak) on a Rivarossi shell points to Con-Cor.
GP38 and GP38-2 share the truck; the BN #2081 (GP38-2) powered-truck photo is the reassembly reference for the SF #3560 (GP38). Gear train runs in a straight line, one gear per axle, idlers between.

shares.relationship: one shared Athearn blue-box 6-axle chassis; shells swap
shares.tell: A shell alone can make a heritage piece on a chassis already owned. Factory roads: U28C SP #7151, UP #2802, PC #6533; U30C incl. BN #5323; U33C SF #8517, GN #2538, SP. Catalog numbers are NOT road numbers (U33C catalog 3501/3502 = roads SF #8517 / GN #2538).
